question.problem:
The diameter of the kibble of a particular cat food brand is normally distributed with a mean of $\mu $ and a standard deviation of $0.7\,\text{mm}.$ Additionally, the diameter of $20%$ of kibbles is less than $4.4\,\text{mm}$ in diameter. Find the percentage of kibbles whose diameter is less than $4\,\text{mm},$ rounded to $1$ decimal place.
